title: What to Change, What to Protect
blurb: A one-page reference for deciding which parts of a recipe are safe to adapt and which ones carry the dish's identity.

blocks.html: Placeholder Kitchen Guide. This one intentionally relates to two lessons, which is the test case for the many-to-many guide and lesson relationship in the navigation spec.

items: The protein, when the cooking method stays similar.
Vegetables that play a supporting role.
The ingredient the dish is named for.
The acid or fat that balances the whole plate.
Anything tied to the memory the dish carries.
